I would like origin or my proposal. split proposal is strange for me (it splits warming and bal insertion). I wouldn't mind either the split (changes in <@774033563732541451> 's reverted PR) or <@429719902363058177> 's proposal. "split" had the support of majority but not many people expressed their opinion on <@429719902363058177> 's proposal. So, should we bring those two prs up on ACDE this week: I have now updated the specs PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/2900 And the EIP: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/compare/master...nerolation:EIPs:toni/state-access Put it on the ACDE agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2115#issuecomment-4709317795 Also, please check the PR again as <@830368514225340436> also raised some issues with it: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/2900 also looping in <@830368514225340436> to help us guide the decision .. and <@796570016966770688> 🙂 Yeah. The decision has to be whether we go with the "split" or implement Dragan's suggestion. The split is conceptually cleaner imo and was agreed upon by all clients except reth iirc. However, the counter argument made was that Dragan's proposal allows clients optimise the implementation. So it would be good to have the clients look at it and agree if its feasible or not. (I don't think we've got a lot of feedback from other clients on it) I guess if people want to optimize for BAL, than my proposal is best outcome. Optimizing for only eip7702 case is underwhelming and it is the firt time that we break warming and BAL bond.
